major_deviations.claim_in_article: The crude oil market was briefly surprised ... and crude oil prices return to a high level if supply worries remain.
major_deviations.issue: The verified price reaction concerns Brent crude futures specifically, but the article frames the observed movement as a general reaction of the crude oil market and crude oil prices.
major_deviations.explanation: This broadens the verified Brent-futures observation to crude oil prices generally. The same broad framing already appears in the Japanese source.
